bio.text: Cindy Golding, a Republican, represents District 83 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Golding as serving a second term.

The biography describes an early career as an analytical chemist at Esmark Corp and a later career as an entrepreneur, business executive, farmer and real estate investor, and lists service as a former chair of the Linn County Republican Central Committee.

It lists Northern Illinois University and Elmhurst University, where Golding majored in biochemistry, and says Golding was born in Chicago, was raised in northern Illinois and lives in rural Linn County.
